reason: Conversation 1 asks focused, sensible questions in sequence (freezer temperature, settings, vent airflow, noises), correctly links the cold freezer, weak fridge airflow and scraping to an iced evaporator from a defrost fault, and suggests a 24h manual defrost. When the fault returned after about 5 days it escalated to an appliance engineer without naming a definite part or giving a part number. It did wrongly ask the customer to remove the back panel, but it accepted their refusal and moved on. Conversation 2 opens with a long generic dump in US units (dollar bill test, Fahrenheit), suggests removing the back panel and replacing the fan motor or air damper, and both of its last two turns are cut off mid-sentence. Its advice to unplug the fridge is fine, but it never gets to the recurrence check or a clear engineer escalation, so it is less efficient and less complete.
